newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen staying out or adding via 8-day system RP.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen staying out or adding via 8-day system RP.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is expected to stay out of the open market or add temporary reserves to the U.S. banking system on Wednesday via eight-day fixed system repurchase agreements, market analysts said.

"I'm looking for an eight-day fixed system RP," said Patricia Thrapp, vice president at Aubrey G. Lanston and Co Inc. Analysts at MCM MoneyWatch were also calling for an eight-day system RP, while analysts at MMS International and Stone & McCarthy Research Associates were calling for no Fed.
At 1010 EDT/1410 GMT, federal funds were in line with the Fed's target rate at 5-1/4 percent.
